question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Bulging
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bulging"** means something that is swelling outward or protruding; it is often used to describe something that is sticking out due to pressure from inside. (फूला हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The bulging walls of the old building were a cause for concern.
 
 
 
• **"Contracting"** refers to the process of becoming smaller or shrinking; it is the opposite of expanding or swelling. (सिकुड़ता हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **During winter, the metal rods were contracting due to the cold temperature.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Weeping** (रोता हुआ): Shedding tears or crying.
 
 
• **Example:** The child was weeping after losing his favorite toy.
 
 
 
• **Swelling** (सूजन): The state of being swollen or expanded.
 
 
• **Example:** There was significant swelling around the injury.
 
 
 
• **Hanging** (लटकता हुआ): Suspended in the air.
 
 
• **Example:** The old lamp was hanging from the ceiling.
